column3: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.
column4: Weaklings... all of them. You, $c, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?$B$BThe Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.$B$BBut before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

column3: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
column4: While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.\r\n\r\nBring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.

column3: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.
column4: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.\r\n\r\nCooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

column3: Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
column4: The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?$b$bThe Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.$b$bDeep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.

column3: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
column4: Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.\r\n\r\nThere is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?

column3: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
column4: I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.$B$BFirst is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.

column3: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
column4: With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.\r\n\r\nWhile you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.

column3: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
column4: We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.\r\n\r\nIf your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

column3: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
column4: My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in Desolace. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed.$B$BJourney to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into Desolace; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.

column3: Go with Ogron to speak with Reethe, then return to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
column4: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.$b$bOgron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.Question Reethe with Ogron
